test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A hemispherical bowl of internal diameter 24 cm is full of a liquid. This liquid is to be filled into cylindrical bottles each of radius 4 cm and height 18 cm. How many such bottles are required to empty the bowl?
solution: Given: Internal diameter of hemispherical bowl = 24 cm The radius of the cylindrical bottle = 4 cm Height of the cylindrical shaped bottle = 18 cm Concept : Volume of hemispherical bowl = n x Volume of one cylindrical-shaped bottle Calculations: Let the number of bottles be n.
